name: Polar Opposites
source:
It has been snowing nonstop for months in a small, lakeside town. News sources and scientists are confused by this phenomenon. Two young travelers, intrigued by the mystery, decide to revisit their hometown to see if they can stop the snowfall. What they discover is much deeper than the piles of snow around them…

[From [url=https://emcatgames.itch.io/polar-opposites]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个湖边小镇已经连续几个月下雪了。新闻来源和科学家对这种现象感到困惑。两个年轻的旅行者对这个谜团很感兴趣，决定重游家乡，看看能否阻止降雪。他们发现的东西比他们周围的雪堆要深得多……
